model: For a vertical cylindrical front, u=(x-mid)/(halfwidth)=sin(theta)*sqrt(1-e^2)/(1-e*cos(theta)), e=ring radius/horizontal camera distance. Invert this for the two adjacent openings. Not an exterior metric survey. Horizontal radial axes and negligible local lateral-axis camera slant assumed. Exterior camera distance not available; 0 orthographic, 0.06–0.18 sensitivity (a circa 3.46m radius at ~19–58m). The two crop views include non-horizontal tilt, shadows and layered cornices: quoted ranges cover hand picks and distance only. The right-hand 2024 extreme grazes the silhouette and interval is weak.
assessment: Two different exterior photographs confirm three adjacent real windows. Credible projected spacing of well seen neighboring pairs around 53–62 degrees supports a roughly six-part angular rhythm. Twelve regular equal angular divisions would put intermediate windows in continuous, unpierced photographed wall. The back of the ring has openings in the engineer interior view; no simultaneous 360-degree sequence, total or uniform pattern has been established. Model only verified windows, report inferred placement at the unseen rear.
